name: X Line Version T 385/65R22.5 160K (158L)
shortDescription: Michelin X Line Version T 385/65 R22.5 160K (158L) — all-season touring tire for SUVs & light trucks.
description: Michelin X Line Version T in size 385/65 R22.5 160K (158L) (385/65R22.5) is a all-season touring tire engineered for commercial truck and regional trailer applications. Designed with a 385 mm section width, 65% aspect ratio, 22.5-inch rim diameter, 1,072 mm (42.2 in)-inch overall diameter, it delivers dependable traction, even treadwear, and confident braking control. Built with a heavy-duty all-steel radial casing rated for load index 160 and speed symbol K. EU Tyre Label (Reg. 2020/740): Class A fuel efficiency, Class B wet grip, and 70 dB (Class A) external rolling noise (EPREL ID 518967). Manufacturer Part Number: 812967, EAN: 3528708129672. Supplied as a brand-new, factory-first quality tire; verify the exact size, load index, and speed rating on your vehicle tire placard before ordering.
highlights: EU Label: Fuel A · Wet B · 70 dB (Class A)

This balanced kit pairs FEA-optimized 6-piston Apollo 2-piece bolted billet aluminum calipers (Red polyester powder-coat finish, stainless-steel pistons, internal fluid crossover passages) with Ø355 mm 2-piece fully floating G3500 high-carbon swept-groove rotors mounted on stainless SD-system bobbins. description: EBC Racing Apollo 6-Piston Front Big Brake Kit Ø355 mm, Red (BBK064RED-1) (EAN: 5050953410307) is a flagship motorsport-grade big brake system designed and manufactured in Northampton, England by EBC Brakes Racing for the front axle. This balanced kit pairs FEA-optimized 6-piston Apollo 2-piece bolted billet aluminum calipers (Red polyester powder-coat finish, stainless-steel pistons, internal fluid crossover passages) with Ø355 mm 2-piece fully floating G3500 high-carbon swept-groove rotors mounted on stainless SD-system bobbins. name: EBC Racing Apollo 6-Piston Front Brake Caliper, Red, RH (BC6104RED-R)

description: EBC Racing Apollo 6-Piston Front Brake Caliper, Red, RH (BC6104RED-R) (EAN: 5050953045295) is a lightweight competition & fast-road 6-piston brake caliper CNC-machined from heat-treated billet aluminum in Northampton, England by EBC Brakes Racing. Featuring high-tensile 12.9-grade steel bridge bolts for maximum caliper body stiffness, staggered stainless-steel pistons with high-temperature dust and pressure seals, and a durable Red high-temperature finish, it accepts standard DP006 (152 mm) performance pad profiles and pairs with Ø330–355 mm rotors. Verified fitment for Audi A3 / S3 (2020–2026), Audi A4 / S4 (2016–2026), Volkswagen Golf / GTI / Golf R (2020–2026), Cupra Leon (2021–2026).

name: Ferodo Racing DS2500 High-Performance Front Brake Pad Set (FCP393)
shortDescription: Ferodo Racing DS2500 track & fast-road brake pad set · Front axle · MPN FCP393
description: Ferodo Racing DS2500 High-Performance Front Brake Pad Set (FCP393) (EAN: 4044197936076) is a track-proven DS2500 high-temperature brake pad set engineered in Mondovì, Italy by Ferodo Racing for the front axle. Formulated with Ferodo's race-bred heavy-duty DS2500 (H) friction compound, it maintains a remarkably flat 0.42–0.48 coefficient of friction from cold street stops all the way to 650°C track temperatures. Ultra-low compressibility (< 1.5%) and factory pre-scorched thermal bedding provide immediate, linear pedal feel and minimal rotor wear during fast-road, canyon, and track-day driving. Verified fitment for Peugeot 208 / e-208 (2019–2026), Peugeot 308 / e-308 (2022–2026), Peugeot 2008 / e-2008 (2020–2026), Citroen C3 / e-C3 (2017–2026).

name: Ferodo Racing DS2500 High-Performance Front Brake Pad Set (FCP1640)
shortDescription: Ferodo Racing DS2500 track & fast-road brake pad set · Front axle · MPN FCP1640
description: Ferodo Racing DS2500 High-Performance Front Brake Pad Set (FCP1640) (EAN: 4044197400881) is a track-proven DS2500 high-temperature brake pad set engineered in Mondovì, Italy by Ferodo Racing for the front axle. Formulated with Ferodo's race-bred heavy-duty DS2500 (H) friction compound, it maintains a remarkably flat 0.42–0.48 coefficient of friction from cold street stops all the way to 650°C track temperatures. Ultra-low compressibility (< 1.5%) and factory pre-scorched thermal bedding provide immediate, linear pedal feel and minimal rotor wear during fast-road, canyon, and track-day driving. Verified fitment for Opel Corsa / Corsa-e (2020–2026), Opel Mokka / Mokka-e (2021–2026), Citroen C5 Aircross (2019–2026), Peugeot 408 (2023–2026).
